title.en: China tests long-range missile in South Pacific in move Australia condemns as ‘destabilising to region’
title.zh: 中国在南太平洋试射远程导弹，澳大利亚谴责此举“破坏地区稳定”

summary.en: China has conducted a long-range missile test in the South Pacific, a move that the Australian government condemned as “destabilising to the region.” Australia confirmed it was informed by China of its intent to conduct the test.
summary.zh: 中国在南太平洋进行了一次远程导弹试验，澳大利亚政府谴责此举“破坏地区稳定”。澳大利亚证实中国已告知其进行此次试验的意图。

body.en: Australian government confirms it was informed by China of its intent to conduct the test on Monday China has conducted a long-range missile test in the South Pacific, in a move the Australian government condemned as “destabilising to the region” and which was also criticised by other regional leaders. A ⁠test missile topped with ‌a ‌dummy warhead landed ‌in “designated waters” of the Pacific, China’s state news agency Xinhua ‌reported on Monday. The missile test was a “routine arrangement” of China’s annual ⁠military training, with prior notification to relevant countries, Xinhua said. Continue reading...
body.zh: 澳大利亚政府证实，中国周一已告知其进行这次试验的意图。中国在南太平洋进行了一次远程导弹试验，澳大利亚政府谴责此举“破坏了该地区的稳定”，并遭到了其他地区领导人的批评。中国官方通讯社新华社周一报道称，一枚装有虚拟弹头的测试导弹落入太平洋“指定水域”。新华社称，此次导弹试射是中国年度军事训练的“例行安排”，事先通知了有关国家。继续阅读...

reflection.en: News of long-range missile tests can heighten regional tensions, reminding us of the global challenge to peace. The prophet Isaiah envisioned a future where nations would transform their weapons into tools for constructive purposes, learning war no more. This vision calls us to pray for leaders to pursue paths of mutual trust and disarmament, rather than...
reflection.zh: 远程导弹试验的消息可能加剧地区紧张局势，提醒我们全球和平所面临的挑战。先知以赛亚曾预见一个未来，各国将把武器铸成工具用于建设，不再学习战事。这一愿景呼吁我们为领导人祷告，愿他们寻求互信与裁军的道路，而非升级军事能力。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Anthony Albanese’s ‘shag, marry, date-gate’ underscores the double-edged sword of social media appearances
title.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯“性、婚、恋门”事件凸显社交媒体亮相的双刃剑效应

summary.en: The Australian Prime Minister, Anthony Albanese, faced public scrutiny after comments made during a social media appearance led to a minor scandal, highlighting the intense public nature of modern politics and the risks associated with online engagement.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯在一次社交媒体露面中发表的言论引发了一场小风波，凸显了现代政治的强烈公众属性以及在线互动所带来的风险。

body.en: Everything in Canberra is content now, from performative questions to calculated outbursts and comments about Kylie Minogue Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Anthony Albanese probably didnt expect an interview with a comedian in her “Bush Barbie” character would have kickstarted the biggest firestorm of the week. But the prime minister, appearing alongside a stuffed copy of his beloved cavoodle Toto – fell victim to an entirely avoidable and regrettable controversy when he played along with a “shag, marry, date” game. Continue reading...
body.zh: 现在，堪培拉的一切都很满意，从表演性问题到精心策划的爆发和对凯莉·米洛的评论关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客安东尼·阿尔博内斯可能没有想到对扮演“布什芭比”角色的喜剧演员的采访会引发本周最大的风暴。但这位首相出现在他心爱的托托玩具的毛绒玩具旁边，当他玩“上床、结婚、约会”游戏时，他成了一场完全可以避免且令人遗憾的争议的受害者。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident reminds us how quickly a few words, especially in the public eye, can ignite widespread discussion and controversy. Just as a small spark can set a large forest ablaze, seemingly minor comments can have significant and unforeseen consequences in the digital age. It underscores the need for wisdom and carefulness in all our communication.
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，尤其是在公众视野中，寥寥数语能多么迅速地引发广泛讨论和争议。正如小小的火花能点燃大片森林，看似微不足道的言论在数字时代也可能带来重大且意想不到的后果。这强调了我们在所有沟通中都需要智慧和谨慎。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: Australia news live: China conducts long-range missile test in the Pacific as Wong calls it ‘destabilising to region’
title.zh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：中国在太平洋进行远程导弹试验，黄英贤称其“破坏地区稳定”

summary.en: China conducted a long-range missile test in the Pacific, which Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong described as destabilizing to the region.
summary.zh: 中国在太平洋进行了一次远程导弹试验，澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤称此举“破坏地区稳定”。

body.en:
China’s ⁠military conducted a test ⁠launch ⁠of a strategic missile from ⁠a submarine, with a ⁠test missile topped with ‌a ‌dummy warhead landing ‌in “designated waters” of the Pacific, state news agency Xinhua ‌reported on Monday.

Reuters reports that Xinhua said the missile test was a “routine arrangement” of China’s annual ⁠military training, with prior notification to relevant countries.

reflection.en: News of long-range missile tests can heighten regional tensions and remind us of the fragility of peace. Yet, even amidst such displays of power, we hold onto the hope that Yahweh ultimately brings an end to all conflict. He is the one who will one day break the instruments of war and establish lasting peace.
reflection.zh: 远程导弹试验的消息可能加剧地区紧张局势，并提醒我们和平的脆弱性。然而，即使在这样的武力展示中，我们仍怀抱希望，相信雅伟最终会结束一切冲突。祂是那将有一天折断战争工具、建立持久和平的。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: Russia launches deadly attacks on Kyiv on eve of Nato summit
title.zh: 俄罗斯在北约峰会前夕对基辅发动致命袭击

summary.en: Russian missiles and drones struck Kyiv early on Monday, killing at least nine people and heavily damaging apartment blocks and other buildings, marking the second major assault on the city in less than a week, according to officials. The attacks occurred on the eve of a NATO summit.
summary.zh: 官员称，俄罗斯导弹和无人机周一早些时候袭击了基辅，造成至少九人死亡，公寓楼和其他建筑物严重受损，这是该市在不到一周内遭受的第二次重大袭击。这些袭击发生在北约峰会前夕。

body.en: At least nine killed in the Ukraine capital in the second major assault on the city and its surrounds in less than a week Russian missiles and drones ⁠struck Kyiv early on Monday, killing at least nine people and heavily damaging apartment blocks and other buildings, officials said, just a few days after ⁠the deadliest assault ⁠on the Ukrainian capital ​this year. “Nine deaths and 46 wounded have now been confirmed as a result of the Russian attack (including five wounded children),” Tymur Tkachenko, head of the Kyiv region’s military administration, said. “Sadly, this is not the final toll. Rescue operations are still ongoing.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 官员们表示，乌克兰首都在不到一周的时间里对该市及其周边地区进行了第二次重大袭击，造成至少九人死亡。俄罗斯导弹和无人机周一早些时候袭击了基辅，造成至少九人死亡，并严重损坏了公寓楼和其他建筑物，就在今年乌克兰首都遭受最严重袭击的几天后。基辅地区军事管理局局长泰穆尔·特卡琴科 (Tymur Tkachenko) 表示：“现已确认俄罗斯袭击造成 9 人死亡、46 人受伤（其中包括 5 名受伤儿童）。” “遗憾的是，这还不是最终死亡人数。救援行动仍在进行中。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of deadly attacks and loss of life in Kyiv brings profound sorrow. In moments of such tragedy, we remember that Yahweh, in Christ, shares in our grief, as He wept at the tomb of His friend. This simple act reminds us that compassion and lament are fitting responses to suffering and death.
reflection.zh: 基辅遭受致命袭击并造成生命损失的消息令人深感悲痛。在这样的悲剧中，我们记得雅伟在基督里与我们一同悲伤，正如祂在朋友的墓前哭泣一样。这一简单的举动提醒我们，同情和哀悼是对苦难和死亡的恰当回应。

verse.textEn: Jesus wept.
verse.textZh: 耶稣哭了。

title.en: Sky owner announces £1.6bn takeover of ITV’s broadcasting arm
title.zh: 天空电视台母公司宣布以16亿英镑收购独立电视公司广播业务

summary.en: US telecom giant Comcast, owner of Sky, has announced a £1.6bn deal to acquire ITV’s broadcasting and streaming arm. This acquisition aims to create the UK’s largest commercial broadcaster.
summary.zh: 美国电信巨头康卡斯特（Comcast）旗下的天空电视台（Sky）宣布，将以16亿英镑收购英国独立电视公司（ITV）的广播和流媒体业务。此举旨在打造英国最大的商业广播公司。

body.en: US telecom giant Comcast to snap up free-to-air TV channels and streaming platform to create UK’s biggest commercial broadcaster Sky has announced a long awaited £1.6bn deal to buy ITV’s broadcasting and streaming arm to create the UK’s biggest commercial broadcaster. Sky, which is owned by the US telecoms company Comcast, will pay £1.2bn in cash initially for ITV’s media and entertainment business, which include its free-to-air TV channels in the UK and ITVX streaming platform. It has agreed to pay a further up to £200m in the second half of 2028, depending on 2027 advertising revenues. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国电信巨头康卡斯特将收购免费电视频道和流媒体平台，创建英国最大的商业广播公司 Sky 宣布了一项期待已久的 16 亿英镑交易，收购 ITV 的广播和流媒体部门，创建英国最大的商业广播公司。美国电信公司康卡斯特旗下的 Sky 最初将向 ITV 的媒体和娱乐业务支付 12 亿英镑现金，其中包括其在英国的免费电视频道和 ITVX 流媒体平台。它已同意在 2028 年下半年进一步支付最多 2 亿英镑，具体取决于 2027 年的广告收入。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This significant business acquisition highlights the scale of human ambition and strategic planning in the commercial world. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us that when we commit our work to Yahweh, our plans will succeed.
reflection.zh: 这项重大的商业收购彰显了商业世界中人类的雄心和战略规划的规模。箴言16:3提醒我们，当我们把工作交托给雅伟时，我们的计划就会成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: At least 10 killed in second Russian strikes on Kyiv in a week
title.zh: 基辅一周内第二次遭俄军袭击，至少10人死亡

summary.en: At least 10 people were killed and 46 injured, including five children, in Russian strikes on Kyiv, marking the second such attack on the capital within a week.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯对基辅的袭击造成至少10人死亡，46人受伤，其中包括5名儿童，这是该首都一周内第二次遭受此类袭击。

body.en:
At least 10 people have been killed following a second night of Russian strikes on Kyiv in a week, the capital's top military administrator has said.

Rescue efforts are continuing at over 20 locations, Tkachenko posted on Telegram, adding that residential high-rise buildings were hit in two districts.

The strikes come on the eve of the Nato summit in Turkey, where Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky is expected to hold talks with President Trump.

Hours before the latest strikes, Zelensky warned that Moscow was preparing a second "massive strike" on Kyiv following its attacks on Thursday that killed 30 people.

Russian ballistic missiles hit several buildings across the city, Mayor Vitaly Klitschko said, adding that fires had broken out in some apartment complexes.

Photos emerging from Kyiv show smouldering wreckage and charred cars littered throughout the city. Footage also shows crews continuing to comb through wreckage on Monday morning to find survivors.

Zelensky said on Sunday, hours ahead of the strikes, that intelligence indicated that Kyiv would come under a second wave of Russian attacks in a week.

After a barrage of drone and missile strikes through Thursday night, tens of thousands of residents evacuated to metro stations around the city as alarms blared in the early hours of Friday morning.

Ukraine accused Moscow of deliberately attacking civilian areas in the attack, which left at least 30 people dead. Russia said it had targeted military and energy bases in retaliation for recent Ukrainian strikes on power stations and energy facilities in Russian territory.

Such attacks continued overnight with power being cut off temporarily in the city of Sevastopol in Russian-occupied Crimea.

Ahead of the Nato meeting, Zelensky urged allies to not delay on supplies of long-range missiles to be used against Russia.

He wrote on X: "Any delay with missiles for our air defense... means the loss of lives, and it encourages Russia to continue the war."

Zelensky has also appealed to the US to grant Ukraine licences to manufacture Patriot defence missiles.
body.zh: 首都最高军事长官表示，俄罗斯一周内第二晚对基辅发动袭击，造成至少 10 人死亡。 特卡琴科在 Telegram 上发帖称，20 多个地点的救援工作仍在继续，并补充说，两个地区的高层住宅建筑遭到袭击。 此次袭击发生在北约土耳其峰会前夕，预计乌克兰总统泽伦斯基将与特朗普总统举行会谈。 在最近一次袭击发生前几个小时，泽连斯基警告说，继周四发生导致 30 人死亡的袭击后，莫斯科正准备对基辅进行第二次“大规模袭击”。 市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，俄罗斯弹道导弹击中了该市的几座建筑物，并补充说一些公寓大楼发生了火灾。 来自基辅的照片显示，整个城市散落着阴燃的残骸和烧焦的汽车。视频还显示，周一早上，工作人员继续在残骸中搜寻幸存者。 泽伦斯基周日在袭击发生前几个小时表示，情报显示基辅将在一周内遭受俄罗斯的第二波袭击。 周四晚上，无人机和导弹连续袭击后，周五凌晨警报拉响，数万名居民疏散到城市各地的地铁站。 乌克兰指责莫斯科在此次袭击中故意袭击平民区，造成至少30人死亡。俄罗斯表示，它已将军事和能源基地作为目标，以报复乌克兰最近对俄罗斯境内发电站和能源设施的袭击。 此类袭击持续了一夜，俄罗斯占领的克里米亚塞瓦斯托波尔市的电力暂时被切断。 在北约会议之前，泽连斯基敦促盟国不要推迟供应用于对抗俄罗斯的远程导弹。 他在X上写道：“我们防空导弹的任何延误……都意味着生命损失，这会鼓励俄罗斯继续战争。” 泽伦斯基还呼吁美国授予乌克兰制造爱国者防御导弹的许可证。

reflection.en: The news of innocent lives lost and injured, including children, in ongoing strikes brings profound sorrow. In such moments of deep pain and mourning, our hearts long for a world where tears, crying, and suffering are no more. Revelation 21:4 offers a future hope where Yahweh Himself will wipe away every tear, and death and pain will be forever banished.
reflection.zh: 持续的袭击导致无辜生命，包括儿童的逝去和受伤，令人深感悲痛。在如此深切的痛苦和哀伤时刻，我们的心渴望一个不再有眼泪、哭泣和苦难的世界。启示录21:4提供了一个未来的盼望，雅伟亲自擦去所有的眼泪，死亡和痛苦将永远被消除。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Why Ukrainian strikes on annexed Crimea are a blow to Putin
title.zh: 乌克兰对被吞并的克里米亚的袭击为何对普京构成打击

summary.en: Eastern Europe correspondent Sarah Rainsford explains the strategic importance of Crimea as a target for Kyiv and its significance to Vladimir Putin.
summary.zh: 东欧记者莎拉·雷恩斯福德解释了克里米亚作为基辅目标的重要性，以及它对弗拉基米尔·普京的意义。

body.en:
A resident inside Crimea has told the BBC the situation there is "catastrophic", as Ukrainian drones strike oil refineries and power plants on the peninsula, as well as military targets.

The strikes on Russian-annexed Crimea have increased significantly in recent weeks - partly to cut off supply lines to Russian troops attacking Ukraine from the south.

Eastern Europe correspondent Sarah Rainsford explains why Kyiv is striking now and why the peninsula matters to Vladimir Putin personally.
body.zh: 克里米亚境内的一名居民告诉英国广播公司，乌克兰无人机袭击了半岛上的炼油厂和发电厂以及军事目标，那里的局势是“灾难性的”。 最近几周，对俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚的袭击大幅增加，部分原因是为了切断从南部攻击乌克兰的俄罗斯军队的补给线。 东欧记者萨拉·雷恩斯福德 (Sarah Rainsford) 解释了为什么基辅现在正在罢工，以及为什么半岛对弗拉基米尔·普京个人很重要。

reflection.en: This news highlights the intense human struggle for control over land, where territory becomes a symbol of national identity and power. Yet, from a divine perspective, all the earth and its fullness belong to Yahweh, challenging our ultimate claims to ownership. This reminds us that while nations contend for dominion, true sovereignty rests with the Creator.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻突显了人类对土地控制权的激烈争夺，领土成为国家认同和权力的象征。然而，从神的角度看，全地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟，这挑战了我们对所有权的最终主张。这提醒我们，尽管各国争夺统治权，但真正的至高主权在于造物主。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: 'Destabilising ': Australia criticises China after ballistic missile test launch in the Pacific
title.zh: 澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试射，称其“破坏稳定”

summary.en: Australia has criticized China following a ballistic missile test launch by a nuclear submarine in the Pacific, describing the action as "destabilizing."
summary.zh: 澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试射，称此举“破坏稳定”。此次试射由一艘核潜艇进行。

body.en:
Australia and New Zealand have sounded the alarm after China confirmed it successfully tested a submarine-launched ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

Chinese state media Xinhua reported that the testing is part of China's annual military exercise, and it has alerted relevant countries in advance, in accordance with international law and rules.

China has no specific countries targeted and goals behind today's test, Xinhua said.

This comes after Australia and Fiji signed a major defence alliance earlier in the day, committing each country to come to the other's aid in case either is attacked.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Australian government had been advised in advance by China of the test.

"Australia has been clear with China that we regard this as destabilising to the region," she told reporters on Monday, moments before the launch was confirmed.

"This proposed test is in the context of a rapid military buildup by China, which is lacking in the transparency and reassurance as to intent that the region expects."

Wong said the test was "inconsistent" with Pacific leaders' requests for the ocean to be one "of peace".

"It appears that, despite our long-standing concerns about this type of activity, China carried out the test within hours of informing us," he said in a statement.

"The Pacific is an Ocean of Peace and we are deeply concerned by China's testing of nuclear-capable weapons into the South Pacific."

The Sydney Morning Herald and The Australian newspapers both earlier reported that Chinese officials briefed regional governments, including Australia, about an upcoming intercontinental ballistic missile test in the Pacific.

The Chinese embassy in Australia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

China last tested an intercontinental ballistic missile in 2024, a rare event that highlighted the country's increasing military capabilities.

Data from Starboard Maritime Intelligence, a New Zealand ship tracking company, showed three Chinese satellite-tracking vessels positioned throughout the Pacific.

Two vessels left China around 25 June and currently sit near the Federated States of Micronesia. The third departed China in early May and is currently at harbour in Fiji's capital, Suva.

title.en: 'I ate ketchup and cheese,' says Venezuelan girl trapped under quake rubble for 32 hours
title.zh: “我吃了番茄酱和奶酪，”委内瑞拉女孩讲述被困地震废墟32小时的经历

summary.en: Fabiana, a Venezuelan girl, was trapped for 32 hours in the rubble of a 10-storey residential building after two earthquakes struck the country in June. She survived by eating ketchup and cheese found amidst the debris.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉女孩法比亚娜在六月两次地震袭击该国后，被困在一栋十层住宅楼的废墟中长达32小时。她靠着在瓦砾中找到的番茄酱和奶酪幸存了下来。

body.en:
Karina Blanco was just about to start the spinning class she teaches when the earth began to shake. The tremors kept getting stronger, so she grabbed her bag and ran outdoors with everyone else.

"When I realised the magnitude of it, I started screaming 'my daughter, my daughter'. I sat in my car and drove as fast as I could," said Karina.

Her only daughter, Fabiana, 12, was at their home when two powerful earthquakes rocked Venezuela within seconds of each other on 24 June. The second quake was one of the strongest tremors to hit the country in a century, at a magnitude of 7.5.

When Karina reached her building in Caraballeda, in northern La Guaira state, she could hardly believe her eyes. "I could see one building, then a gap where my building stood, and then another building."

Inside their first-floor flat in the 10-storey building, Fabiana was in her mother's bedroom when she felt the earthquakes. She ran into the kitchen, and was holding on to the counter, when the walls around her collapsed. She was thrown to the ground.

"I saw things shaking, falling, breaking, and then the walls cracked. The wall separating my apartment from a friend's collapsed. At that moment, I thought, 'I'm going to die. I won't survive this. No-one is going to rescue me,'" said Fabiana.

Outside the collapsed building, Karina saw half of her daughter's bed sticking out of the debris.

"I was running from one end of the complex to the other screaming 'She's dead. My daughter is dead'. I didn't know what to do," said Karina.

Under the collapsed building everything had gone quiet for Fabiana. She was lying face up, trapped by rubble on all sides, with the ceiling almost touching her face.

"I'm someone who gets very anxious and claustrophobic. But I don't know why, a strange calm came over me. Maybe my mind was in shock," she said.

A little while later, a nurse who worked as a carer for her upstairs neighbours started calling out to see if anyone could hear her. Fabiana responded.

Six hours after the earthquake, at around midnight, the nurse was rescued. She told the volunteers who pulled her out that a girl named Fabiana was alive inside.

"I had surrendered to God asking for strength to begin a new life without Fabiana. And then someone told me, 'Your daughter is alive'," said Karina.

She ran back to the building screaming into gaps in the debris, calling out her daughter's name.

"For some reason, I had hope and faith," she said. "One of my legs was bent in a painful position, and I moved some of the rubble so I could straighten it out. While doing that I got scrapes and cuts, but I found a bottle of ketchup and some grated cheese. That's what kept me conscious."

At dawn a group of Venezuelan firefighters came to the building. They went into the rubble and...
body.zh: 卡琳娜·布兰科 (Karina Blanco) 正要开始她所教的动感单车课程时，大地开始震动。颤抖越来越厉害，她抓起包就和大家一起跑到了外面。 “当我意识到事情的严重性时，我开始尖叫‘我的女儿，我的女儿’。我坐在车里，尽可能快地开着，”卡琳娜说。 6 月 24 日，当委内瑞拉发生两次强烈地震时，她 12 岁的独生女法比亚娜 (Fabiana) 正在家里。第二次地震是该国一个世纪以来最强烈的地震之一，震级为 7.5 级。 当卡琳娜到达位于拉瓜伊拉州北部卡拉巴莱达的大楼时，她简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。 “我可以看到一栋建筑，然后是我的建筑所在的间隙，然后是另一栋建筑。” 在这栋 10 层楼的一楼公寓内，法比亚娜感受到地震时正在她母亲的卧室里。她跑进厨房，抓住柜台，这时她周围的墙壁倒塌了。她被扔到了地上。 “我看到东西在摇晃、掉落、破碎，然后墙壁裂开了。将我的公寓与朋友隔开的墙倒塌了。那一刻，我想，‘我要死了。我活不下去了。没有人能救我，’”法比亚娜说。 在倒塌的建筑物外，卡琳娜看到女儿的半张床从废墟中伸出。 卡琳娜说：“我从大楼的一端跑到另一端，尖叫着‘她死了。我女儿死了’。我不知道该怎么办。” 在倒塌的大楼下，法比亚娜一切都变得安静了。她脸朝上躺着，四面八方都被瓦砾困住，天花板几乎碰到了她的脸。 “我是一个非常焦虑和患有幽闭恐惧症的人。但我不知道为什么，一种奇怪的平静笼罩着我。也许我的心很震惊，”她说。 过了一会儿，一位为楼上邻居做护理的护士开始大声喊叫，看看是否有人能听到她的声音。法比亚娜回应道。 地震发生六小时后，午夜左右，护士获救。她告诉把她拉出来的志愿者，里面有一个名叫法比亚娜的女孩还活着。 卡琳娜说：“我向上帝投降，祈求力量让我在没有法比亚娜的情况下开始新的生活。然后有人告诉我，‘你的女儿还活着’。” 她跑回大楼，在废墟的缝隙中尖叫着，呼喊着女儿的名字。 “出于某种原因，我有希望和信念，”她说。 “我的一条腿弯曲得很痛苦，我搬动了一些瓦砾，这样我就可以把它弄直。在这样做的过程中，我被擦伤和割伤，但我发现了一瓶番茄酱和一些磨碎的奶酪。这就是让我保持清醒的原因。” 黎明时分，一群委内瑞拉消防员来到大楼。他们走进废墟，然后……

reflection.en: Fabiana's incredible survival story reminds us that even in the deepest suffering, the human spirit can find resilience and hope. Yahweh often uses trials to build perseverance and character within us, leading to a profound hope that sustains us through unimaginable circumstances. Her simple act of eating to survive speaks to the enduring will to live that...
reflection.zh: 法比亚娜令人难以置信的生存故事提醒我们，即使在最深的苦难中，人类的精神也能找到韧性和希望。雅伟常常使用磨难来在我们里面建立忍耐和品格，从而产生一种深刻的希望，使我们能够度过难以想象的困境。她简单地靠进食求生的行为，彰显了在最绝望的境况中也能迸发出的顽强生命力。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Australia space agency has found 'likely source' of mystery space balls
title.zh: 澳大利亚航天局已找到神秘“太空球”的“可能来源”

summary.en: Australia's space agency has identified the likely origin of mysterious objects found on its coast, determining them to be pressure vessels from a space launch vehicle.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚航天局已确认在其海岸发现的神秘物体很可能来自一个太空运载火箭的压力容器。

body.en:
The Australian Space Agency (ASA) says it has "identified the likely source" of mysterious large balls that had washed up on a beach in northern Queensland this weekend.

The six solid objects discovered on Forrest Beach, to the north of Townsville, were thought to be space debris. The ASA said on Monday that they "appear to be pressure vessels from a space launch vehicle".

The agency added that it was working with international authorities to formally confirm the launch vehicle.

Queensland's fire department said on Sunday that a 50m exclusion zone remained in place, urging anyone who found a suspicious object in the area not to touch them.

It said members of the public who encounter them should immediately move away and call the emergency services.

There was some speculation online that the spheres were propellant tanks for spacecraft, and so could contain residual amounts of a highly flammable or reactive substance.

Crews in protective suits were reportedly seen placing the spheres in hazmat barrels under police guard, over concerns they may contain hazardous substances.

Forrest Beach Takeaway owner Lisa Scobie said the local community was curious to know their origin.

"It's very quiet, not a lot happens here. So having a lot of extra activity... that definitely created a little bit of excitement," she told public broadcaster ABC.

According to the ASA's latest statement, "the objects' location and characteristics are consistent with debris from a foreign rocket body that recently re-entered the atmosphere from orbit".

It is not the first time that such mysterious objects have been spotted on Australia's shoreline.

In 2023, India confirmed that a giant metal dome that washed up on a Western Australian beach near Perth was from one of its rockets.

India's space agency spokesman later told the BBC that it was from one of its Polar Satellite Launch Vehicles (PSLV).

A spherical object similar to those discovered this weekend was also found in remote grassland in Namibia, southern Africa, in 2011.

Experts at the time said they believed it was most likely a fuel tank or bladder tank containing hydrazine - a highly volatile propellant - from an unmanned rocket.
body.zh: 澳大利亚航天局（ASA）表示，它已经“确定了”本周末被冲上昆士兰州北部海滩的神秘大球的“可能来源”。 在汤斯维尔北部的福雷斯特海滩发现的六个固体物体被认为是太空碎片。 ASA 周一表示，它们“似乎是来自太空运载火箭的压力容器”。 该机构补充说，它正在与国际当局合作，正式确认运载火箭。 昆士兰州消防部门周日表示，50m 的禁区仍然存在，敦促任何在该地区发现可疑物体的人不要触摸它们。 声明称，遇到它们的公众应立即离开并致电紧急服务部门。 网上有人猜测这些球体是航天器的推进剂罐，因此可能含有残留量的高度易燃或反应性物质。 据报道，身穿防护服的工作人员将这些球体放入危险品桶中，由警察看守，因为担心它们可能含有危险物质。 福雷斯特海滩外卖店老板丽莎·斯考比 (Lisa Scobie) 表示，当地社区很想知道它们的起源。 “这里非常安静，没有太多事情发生。所以有很多额外的活动......这肯定会产生一点兴奋，”她告诉公共广播公司 ABC。 根据美国宇航局的最新声明，“这些物体的位置和特征与最近从轨道重新进入大气层的外国火箭体的碎片一致”。 这并不是第一次在澳大利亚海岸线上发现此类神秘物体。 2023 年，印度证实，被冲上珀斯附近西澳大利亚海滩的一个巨大金属圆顶来自印度的一枚火箭。 印度航天局发言人后来告诉英国广播公司，它来自印度的一辆极地卫星运载火箭（PSLV）。 2011年，在南部非洲纳米比亚的偏远草原上也发现了与本周末发现的类似的球形物体。 当时的专家表示，他们认为这很可能是无人驾驶火箭中含有联氨（一种高度挥发性推进剂）的燃料箱或气囊箱。

reflection.en: The discovery of the origin of these mysterious objects reminds us of humanity's persistent quest for understanding. Just as Job suggests wisdom can be found by observing creation, scientific inquiry helps us decipher the natural world and even the remnants of our ventures into space. This pursuit of knowledge reflects a deep human desire to comprehend the...
reflection.zh: 这些神秘物体来源的发现，提醒我们人类对理解的持续追求。正如约伯记所言，智慧可以通过观察受造物而获得，科学探究帮助我们解读自然世界，甚至是我们进入太空的遗留物。这种对知识的追求反映了人类理解雅伟所创造的宇宙的深切愿望。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Australian PM apologises for 'inappropriate' comments about Kylie Minogue
title.zh: 澳大利亚总理就其“不当”言论向凯莉·米洛致歉

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has issued an "unequivocal" apology for comments he made that sparked public criticism.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯就其言论引发公众批评一事，发表了“明确”道歉。

body.en:
Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has apologised "unequivocally" for comments he made about popstar Kylie Minogue in a podcast interview last week.

The leader had made an appearance on the Bush Deep podcast with comedian Nikki Osborne, who asked him during a 20-minute interview whether he would "shag, marry or date" Minogue, actress Nicole Kidman or entertainer Rhonda Burchmore.

After initially trying to avoid the question, Albanese said "Oh, Kylie, clearly".

He was quickly met by a wave of condemnation, with one MP calling his remarks "entirely inappropriate", and another adding that they were "disrespectful to women... and demean the office of prime minister".

Osborne, who is best known for posting crude comedy sketches on YouTube, had launched her podcast series earlier this year. Her podcast site describes her as a "wildly inapproriate journalist" who asks "questions no one else would dare".

In a one-line statement issued early on Monday, the prime minister said: "I apologise unequivocally for the comments".

The remarks were made during an interview that took place in the prime minister's official residence in Canberra and which was released at the end of last week.

After Osborne first posed the question, Albanese, who married his partner Jodie Haydon in November, had initially responded: "I've just got married, I'm only six months in."

Community Strong MP Zali Steggall said the remarks were "entirely inappropriate", adding that he "needs to learn to push back, lead by example and call it out as sexist".

Shadow Communications Minister Sarah Henderson said in a post on X the comments were "disrespectful to women, embarrassing to Australians and demean the office of Prime Minister."

Richard Marles, who is acting prime minister while Albanese is on a visit to the Pacific, told news outlet ABC that the government was "utterly committed" to the elevation of women in society.

"From time to time, we obviously do different interviews to the one we are doing now, but I think the other point to make here is that the government that the PM leads is the first in history that has had equality in terms of the number of men and women in cabinet," Marles said on the broadcaster's Radio National Breakfast programme.

Albanese was also asked about the worst gift he had received on an overseas jaunt. He said a "strange" but ultimately "quite good" gift had come from Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi who brought two melons.

"She just came in looking like Pamela Anderson?" said Osborne, as Albanese smiled and waggled his hands in front of his chest.
body.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯为上周在播客采访中对流行歌星凯莉·米洛的言论“明确”道歉。 这位领导人曾与喜剧演员妮基·奥斯本一起出现在 Bush Deep 播客中，后者在 20 分钟的采访中问他是否会“上床、结婚或约会”米洛、女演员妮可·基德曼或艺人朗达·伯奇莫尔。 在最初试图回避这个问题后，阿尔巴尼斯说：“哦，凯莉，显然”。 他很快遭到一波谴责，一名议员称他的言论“完全不恰当”，另一名议员补充说，这些言论“不尊重女性……并贬低了总理办公室”。 奥斯本以在 YouTube 上发布粗俗的喜剧小品而闻名，今年早些时候推出了她的播客系列。她的播客网站将她描述为“极其不恰当的记者”，提出“其他人不敢提出的问题”。 在周一早些时候发表的一份简短声明中，首相表示：“我对这些言论明确表示歉意”。 这些言论是在堪培拉总理官邸接受采访时发表的，该采访于上周末发布。 在奥斯本首次提出这个问题后，于 11 月与伴侣朱迪·海顿 (Jodie Haydon) 结婚的阿尔巴尼斯 (Albanese) 最初回应道：“我刚刚结婚，结婚才六个月。” 社区强人议员扎利·斯特格尔表示，这些言论“完全不恰当”，并补充说，他“需要学会反击，以身作则，并将其斥为性别歧视”。 影子通讯部长莎拉·亨德森(Sarah Henderson)在X上发帖表示，这些言论“对女性不尊重，让澳大利亚人感到尴尬，并贬低了总理办公室”。 阿尔巴尼斯访问太平洋期间，代理总理理查德·马勒斯 (Richard Marles) 告诉新闻媒体美国广播公司 (ABC)，政府“完全致力于”提高妇女在社会中的地位。 马勒斯在国家广播电台的早餐节目中表示：“我们有时会进行与现在不同的采访，但我认为这里要指出的另一点是，总理领导的政府是历史上第一个内阁中男女人数平等的政府。” 阿尔巴内斯还被问及他在海外旅行时收到的最糟糕的礼物。他说，日本首相高市早苗带来了一份“奇怪”但最终“相当不错”的礼物，他带来了两个瓜。 “她刚进来的时候看起来像帕梅拉·安德森？”奥斯本说道，阿尔巴尼斯微笑着，双手在胸前晃动。

reflection.en: Words carry immense weight, and even seemingly minor remarks can have significant public consequences. This incident reminds us of the profound power of our speech, capable of causing offense or fostering understanding. Yahweh calls us to wield our tongues with wisdom, recognizing their capacity for both harm and healing.
reflection.zh: 言语承载着巨大的分量，即使是看似微不足道的评论也可能带来重大的公共影响。这起事件提醒我们言语的深远力量，它既能冒犯他人，也能促进理解。雅伟呼召我们智慧地运用舌头，认识到它既能造成伤害，也能带来医治。

verse.textEn: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.
verse.textZh: 生死在舌头的权下；喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。

title.en: Wildfires rage in Portugal, Greece, France and Spain
title.zh: 葡萄牙、希腊、法国和西班牙野火肆虐

summary.en: Wildfires are currently affecting six countries in southern Europe, with one blaze in southwestern France potentially impacting the Tour de France.
summary.zh: 欧洲南部六国正遭受野火侵袭，其中法国西南部的一场大火可能影响环法自行车赛的第三赛段。

body.en:
Six countries in southern Europe have been hit by wildfires. One of the blazes, in southwestern France, could affect Monday's third stage of the Tour de France, authorities warn.

Firefighters across southern Europe  battled several wildfires on Sunday, with authorities in southwestern France  warning that one blaze could force a partial cancellation of the Tour de France.

Blazes were also reported in Portugal , Greece , Spain and the Balkans, just as the summer tourism season moves into high gear.

European policymakers have warned of a very extreme danger from wildfires this year, particularly during July and August.

French authorities said they would decide by the end of Sunday whether to cancel the third stage of the Tour de France, after a forest fire raged about 60 kilometers (37 miles) from the route.

The fire, at Trevillach in the Pyrenees-Orientales department, broke out on Saturday, leaving two people — a firefighter and a resident — in a life-threatening condition in the hospital.

Some 750 firefighters, 200 vehicles and nine water-bombing helicopters and other aircraft have ‌been deployed to contain the fire, which officials say has a ​frontline stretching 18 kilometers.

Cyclists are due to cross the finish line in Les Angles in the Pyrenees on Monday, and race officials hope the route can be adapted if required.

Around 300 firefighters battled another fire in a mountainous district of France's southeastern Drome department.

Meanwhile, a wildfire burning since Thursday in central Portugal's Vouzela area has scorched an area of 12,000 hectares (30,000 acres), according to the country's Civil Protection authority.

More than 1,200 firefighters have been working to put out the blaze, along with nearly 400 vehicles and 15 aircraft.

By Sunday afternoon, the fire had been somewhat contained, with officials cited in local media as saying that some hot spots remained.

Spain sent reinforcement personnel and vehicles to Portugal on Friday, along with two water bombers. Italy also sent two firefighting aircraft.

In Spain's northeastern Girona region, a wildfire burning since Friday ruined nearly 2,200 hectares (5,400 acres) of land, the EFE news agency reported.

A local fire official said it may not be possible to bring the blaze under control on Sunday.

Almost 50,000 people living nearby were ordered to remain indoors or were evacuated, local media reported.

A man was detained on suspicion of accidentally starting the fire while using an angle grinder for roadside work.

In Greece, a major wildfire broke out on Sunday afternoon west of the capital, Athens.

body.zh: 南欧有六个国家遭受野火袭击。当局警告称，法国西南部的一场火灾可能会影响周一环法自行车赛的第三赛段。 周日，南欧各地的消防队员与多场野火作斗争，法国西南部当局警告说，一场大火可能会迫使环法自行车赛部分取消。 据报道，在夏季旅游旺季进入高峰之际，葡萄牙、希腊、西班牙和巴尔干地区也发生了火灾。 欧洲政策制定者警告说，今年，特别是七月和八月，野火将带来极其严重的危险。 法国当局表示，在距赛道约 60 公里（37 英里）的森林大火肆虐之后，他们将在周日结束前决定是否取消环法自行车赛第三赛段。 周六，东比利牛斯省特雷维拉赫发生火灾，导致医院内两人（一名消防员和一名居民）生命垂危。 大约 750 名消防员、200 辆车辆和 9 架喷水直升机和其他飞机已被部署来控制火势，官员称火势绵延 18 公里。 自行车手们将于周一冲过比利牛斯山脉莱安格尔斯的终点线，比赛官员希望如果需要的话可以调整路线。 大约 300 名消防员正在与法国东南部德龙省山区的另一场火灾进行搏斗。 与此同时，据葡萄牙民防部门称，自周四以来，葡萄牙中部沃泽拉地区发生的野火已烧毁 12,000 公顷（30,000 英亩）的土地。 超过 1,200 名消防员以及近 400 辆汽车和 15 架飞机一直在努力扑灭大火。 到周日下午，火势已得到一定程度的控制，当地媒体援引官员的话说，一些热点仍然存在。 西班牙于周五向葡萄牙派遣了增援人员和车辆以及两架水弹轰炸机。意大利也派出了两架消防机。 据埃菲通讯社报道，在西班牙东北部赫罗纳地区，自周五以来燃烧的野火摧毁了近 2,200 公顷（5,400 英亩）的土地。 当地消防官员表示，周日可能无法控制火势。 据当地媒体报道，附近近 5 万人被命令留在室内或被疏散。 一名男子因涉嫌在路边使用角磨机作业时意外引发火灾而被拘留。 在希腊，周日下午首都雅典以西爆发了一场大火。 官员们表示，超过 150 名消防员和 22 架飞机以及专家团队和...

reflection.en: The widespread wildfires across southern Europe remind us of creation's vulnerability and the deep distress it can experience. As the earth groans under such intense heat and destruction, we are called to reflect on our place within this fragile world.
reflection.zh: 欧洲南部大范围的野火提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，它会经历深切的痛苦。当大地在如此炙热的破坏下呻吟时，我们被呼召反思自身在这个脆弱世界中的位置。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Students leave Gaza to continue studies, others in limbo
title.zh: 学生离开加沙继续学业，其他人前途未卜

summary.en: Palestinian students are seeking to resume their education at international universities, more than three school years after the conflict began in Gaza. While some are finding opportunities abroad, education within Gaza remains disrupted, with schools increasingly relying on online teaching methods.
summary.zh: 以色列与加沙的战争爆发三年多以来，越来越多的巴勒斯坦学生正在海外大学重新开始学业。由于学校扩大了在线教学，加沙的教育尚未恢复正常。

body.en:
More than three school years since the start of Israel's war in Gaza, more Palestinian students are restarting studies at universities abroad. Education has yet to return to normal, as schools expand online teaching.

When 24-year-old Amira Al-Khatib arrived in the Netherlands  from Gaza last week to begin her master's degree at Radboud University, the joy of finally reaching safety and the sorrow of leaving home collided.

"I am so grateful to everyone who supported me and yet, leaving Gaza  was one of the hardest moments I have ever experienced," she told DW from her new home in the town of Nijmegen.

Al-Khatib graduated with a bachelor's degree in computer systems engineering from Gaza's Al-Azhar University in 2025. "For the past two years, I studied in an environment where internet connectivity could not be taken for granted," she said.

The only place where she could get an internet signal was on the roof of her house. "I completed my graduation project with drones flying overhead, placing my hand over my heart every few minutes, hoping I would survive long enough to finish it," she recalled.

"Engineers who have experienced war understand, perhaps better than anyone else, what our communities actually need," she said. "That's why I chose to continue my education in data science and artificial intelligence . My dream is to help build technological systems that remain reliable even during humanitarian crises and emergencies."

Mohammad Herzallah, a 20-year-old engineering student, also left Gaza  last Monday to enroll at The Hague University of Applied Sciences. "Before the war, I never imagined leaving Gaza," he told DW.

"When bombs were falling, I stopped thinking about studies or my career," he said. He had hoped to resume studies in Gaza after the war. "But the  situation only worsened , so I applied abroad even though I did not want to leave my family."

Both students received scholarships through the Gazan Student Support Network (GSSN), an Amman-based NGO established in January 2024 to help students from Gaza continue their higher education.

"There are so many bureaucratic obstacles, and every country has its own challenges," said GSSN Executive Director Mabrookah Heneidi. In the Netherlands, for example, securing approval for the students took over eight months and involved court cases brought by universities.

For 62 other Palestinian students with Malaysian scholarships, their date of departure remains uncertain. "They have obtained transit approval from Jordan  but cannot leave Gaza because Malaysia does not have diplomatic relations with Israel," said Heneidi.

body.zh: 自以色列加沙战争爆发三个多学年以来，越来越多的巴勒斯坦学生开始在国外大学重新开始学习。随着学校扩大在线教学，教育尚未恢复正常。 当 24 岁的阿米拉·阿尔哈提卜 (Amira Al-Khatib) 上周从加沙抵达荷兰，开始在拉德堡德大学 (Radboud University) 攻读硕士学位时，终于安全抵达的喜悦与离开家的悲伤发生了冲突。 “我非常感谢所有支持我的人，然而，离开加沙是我经历过的最艰难的时刻之一，”她在奈梅亨镇的新家告诉德国之声。 Al-Khatib 于 2025 年从加沙爱资哈尔大学毕业，获得计算机系统工程学士学位。“过去两年，我在一个不能认为互联网连接是理所当然的环境中学习，”她说。 她唯一能收到网络信号的地方就是她家的屋顶。 “我在无人机飞过头顶的情况下完成了我的毕业设计，每隔几分钟我就把手放在我的心上，希望我能活到足够长的时间来完成它，”她回忆道。 “经历过战争的工程师也许比任何人都更了解我们的社区真正需要什么，”她说。 “这就是为什么我选择继续接受数据科学和人工智能方面的教育。我的梦想是帮助建立即使在人道主义危机和紧急情况下也能保持可靠的技术系统。” 20 岁的工程系学生穆罕默德·赫扎拉 (Mohammad Herzallah) 上周一也离开加沙，前往海牙应用科学大学就读。 “战前，我从未想象过离开加沙，”他告诉德国之声。 “当炸弹落下时，我不再考虑学习或我的职业，”他说。他曾希望战后能在加沙恢复学业。 “但情况只会变得更糟，所以我申请出国，尽管我不想离开我的家人。” 两名学生都通过加沙学生支持网络 (GSSN) 获得了奖学金，该网络是一家总部位于安曼的非政府组织，成立于 2024 年 1 月，旨在帮助加沙学生继续接受高等教育。 GSSN 执行董事 Mabrookah Heneidi 表示：“存在如此多的官僚障碍，每个国家都有自己的挑战。”例如，在荷兰，学生获得批准花了八个多月的时间，并涉及大学提起的法庭案件。 对于其他 62 名获得马来西亚奖学金的巴勒斯坦学生来说，他们的出发日期仍不确定。赫内迪说：“他们已获得约旦过境许可，但无法离开加沙，因为马来西亚与以色列没有外交关系。” 她解释说，所有学生离境都必须通过加沙与以色列边境的凯雷姆沙洛姆过境点。然而到目前为止，...

reflection.en: The determination of these students to pursue their education amidst profound disruption reflects a deep human longing for purpose and a future. Even when circumstances are dire, Yahweh's promise of plans for hope and a future can sustain those striving to rebuild their lives and pursue knowledge. This pursuit of learning, even in exile, is a testament to...
reflection.zh: 这些学生在巨大动荡中坚持求学的决心，反映了人类对目标和未来的深切渴望。即使在严峻的环境下，雅伟关于赐予希望和未来的应许，也能支撑那些努力重建生活和追求知识的人。这种即使在流亡中也坚持学习的精神，是对持久希望的见证。

verse.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you, declares Yahweh, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verse.textZh: 我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。这是雅伟说的。

title.en: China's tech rise reshapes the global space race
title.zh: 中国科技崛起重塑全球太空竞赛

summary.en: China is advancing significantly in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space, demonstrating growing technological leadership. This development positions Beijing as a major rival to the United States on a global scale.
summary.zh: 中国在全球研究排名中取得领先，并扩大了其在太空领域的雄心。随着技术领导力的增强，北京正在全球范围内将自己定位为美国的竞争对手。

body.en:
China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.

Lai Kai-ying, the first female Chinese civilian to reach outer space, is currently on board China's crewed Tiangong space station , where she orbits the Earth 16 times a day, alongside two other Chinese astronauts.

Tiangong is a unique microgravity laboratory for scientific experiments, designed to provide new insights into humanity's future.

Today, aviation and spaceflight are once again shaped by ideological rivalry, echoing the mid-20th-century space race between the United States and the Soviet Union. In the 21st century, however, Washington's primary competitor is no longer Moscow, but Beijing.

US space agency NASA intends to retire its landmark research outpost, the International Space Station (ISS), by 2032. When that happens, China will be the only country operating a permanently crewed orbital station.

Space travel is just one of many fields worldwide in which China now holds a technological lead, according to Nature.

The journal's latest index of research leaders , which reveals the leading institutions and countries/territories, puts China in first place — well ahead of the United States and Germany . 

Nine of the Top 10 research institutions were from China, with the US' Harvard ranking third. Germany's Max Planck Society (MPG), Germany's preeminent research organization, ranked in 13th place.

"It is now almost irrelevant which global rankings you consult. Universities and research institutions in China lead in many fields," observed Christina Beck, spokesperson for the MPG.

The Nature Index also shows that Chinese research institutions are the clear leaders in biology, chemistry and physics, as well as in other applied sciences. Only in health sciences and the social sciences have they been surpassed by US institutions.

China's rise has taken place steadily over the past two decades, said Richard Heidler, director of information management at the German Research Foundation (DFG), Germany's largest research funding organization.

"While in the early 2000s it was primarily the volume of publications that increased significantly, bibliometric analyses over the past decade have also shown growing gains in impact-related indicators, such as the share and number of highly cited publications," Heidler said.

In other words, China is not only publishing more, but is becoming increasingly better and more visible, which the MPG's Beck said is based on a long-term development process.

body.zh: 中国在全球研究排名中处于领先地位，并扩大了其在太空领域的雄心。随着技术领先地位的不断增强，北京正在将自己定位为美国在全球范围内的竞争对手。 赖凯英是第一位到达外太空的中国女性平民，目前正在中国载人天宫空间站上，与另外两名中国宇航员一起每天绕地球运行 16 圈。 天宫是一个独特的微重力科学实验实验室，旨在为人类的未来提供新的见解。 如今，航空和航天再次受到意识形态竞争的影响，与20世纪中叶美国和苏联之间的太空竞赛相呼应。然而，进入21世纪，华盛顿的主要竞争对手不再是莫斯科，而是北京。 美国航天局 (NASA) 计划在 2032 年之前退役其具有里程碑意义的研究前哨站——国际空间站 (ISS)。届时，中国将成为唯一运营永久载人轨道站的国家。 据《自然》杂志报道，太空旅行只是中国目前在全球拥有技术领先地位的众多领域之一。 该杂志最新的研究领袖指数揭示了领先的机构和国家/地区，其中中国位居榜首，远远领先于美国和德国。 排名前十的研究机构中有九家来自中国，美国哈佛大学排名第三。德国杰出的研究组织德国马克斯·普朗克学会 (MPG) 排名第 13 位。 MPG发言人克里斯蒂娜·贝克(Christina Beck)表示：“现在，你参考哪个全球排名几乎已经无关紧要了。中国的大学和研究机构在许多领域都处于领先地位。” 自然指数还显示，中国研究机构在生物学、化学和物理学以及其他应用科学领域处于明显领先地位。只有在健康科学和社会科学领域被美国机构超越。 德国最大的研究资助机构德国研究基金会（DFG）信息管理部主任理查德·海德勒表示，中国在过去二十年中稳步崛起。 海德勒说：“虽然在 2000 年代初期，主要是出版物数量显着增加，但过去十年的文献计量分析也显示，与影响力相关的指标不断增长，例如高被引出版物的份额和数量。” 换句话说，中国不仅出版得更多，而且变得越来越好、越来越引人注目，MPG的贝克表示，这是基于长期发展过程的。 “其中的关键是多年来对中国科研机构和大学持续、系统的资助——......

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in technology and space exploration, as seen in China's growing leadership, reflect a time when human knowledge is indeed increasing. This pursuit of understanding and capability, while impressive, reminds us to consider the ultimate purpose of such endeavors and the wisdom needed to navigate their global implications.
reflection.zh: 中国在科技和太空探索方面的迅速进步，展现了人类知识不断增长的时代。这种对理解和能力的追求固然令人瞩目，但也提醒我们思考这些努力的最终目的，以及驾驭其全球影响所需的智慧。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Why US train travel lags behind Asia and Europe
title.zh: 美国火车旅行为何落后于亚洲和欧洲

summary.en: As flights get pricier and gas prices stay high, more US travelers are turning to trains — and hitting a system built for freight, not people.
summary.zh: 随着机票价格上涨和汽油价格居高不下，越来越多的美国旅客转向火车出行——却发现铁路系统是为货运而非客运而建。

body.en:
As flights get pricier and gas prices stay high, more US travelers are turning to trains — and hitting a system built for freight, not people.

Historically overlooked, train travel in the US is having a moment. Passenger numbers have hit new records for the past two years. With aviation fuel and gas prices still running well above pre-Iran war levels, even more travelers may be looking to passenger rails to avoid costly airfare and trips to the gas pump this summer travel season.

But those unfamiliar with the country's train network may be disappointed. Many cities don't have good rail connections, or the kind of high-speed services common in European and East Asian countries.

And there's a paradox here, because the US actually has more railroads than anywhere in the world. So where is the disconnect?

The mid-to-late 19th century was something of a heyday for rail travel in the US. Thousands of miles of track were laid to connect the coasts and ferry both people and goods from one side of the country to the other. But it didn't last. By the middle of the 20th century, the US had prioritized federal funding for highway and airport development over that for railroads, making automobile and plane travel far more efficient than passenger rail lines.

So unlike many European countries, which have long seen passenger trains as a critical public good , the US prioritized more profitable freight trains. That legacy lives on today with much of the nation's track infrastructure now designed for carrying heavy goods rather than passengers at high speeds.

US passenger rail company Amtrak's most popular route is a case in point. Known as the Northeast corridor, it connects cities between Boston and Washington DC, taking around seven hours to cover the full 457 miles (735 kilometers). By comparison, trains can complete the slightly longer route between the Italian cities of Napoli and Milan in just under five hours.

Allan Zarembski, director of the University of Delaware's railroad engineering and safety program, says part of the reason the Northeast corridor's rails cannot accommodate high-speed trains is because they curve to the shape of the land. And that would be complex to change.

"Straightening out the track is a very expensive proposition," he said. "I have to acquire the land. The land is owned by somebody, and often that somebody doesn't want to sell it. … We're talking about going through the most densely populated portion of the United States."

While the Northeast corridor is not currently capable of supporting high-speed rail, California had hoped to set a positive example.

body.zh: 随着航班价格上涨和汽油价格居高不下，越来越多的美国旅客转向火车，并选择了为货运而不是客运而建立的系统。 历史上被忽视的火车旅行在美国现在正迎来一个时刻。过去两年，客运量屡创新高。由于航空燃油和天然气价格仍远高于伊朗战争前的水平，今年夏季旅游旺季，更多旅客可能会寻求客运铁路，以避免昂贵的机票和前往加油站。 但那些不熟悉该国火车网络的人可能会感到失望。许多城市没有良好的铁路连接，也没有欧洲和东亚国家常见的高速服务。 这里有一个悖论，因为美国实际上拥有比世界上任何地方都多的铁路。那么脱节在哪里呢？ 十九世纪中后期是美国铁路旅行的鼎盛时期。铺设了数千英里的轨道来连接海岸，并将人员和货物从该国的一侧运送到另一侧。但这种情况并没有持续多久。到 20 世纪中叶，美国将联邦资金优先用于高速公路和机场的开发，而不是铁路的开发，这使得汽车和飞机旅行的效率远远高于客运铁路。 因此，与许多长期以来将客运列车视为重要公共产品的欧洲国家不同，美国优先考虑利润更高的货运列车。这一传统至今仍在延续，美国的大部分轨道基础设施现在都设计用于高速运输重型货物而不是乘客。 美国客运铁路公司Amtrak最受欢迎的路线就是一个很好的例子。它被称为东北走廊，连接波士顿和华盛顿特区之间的城市，大约需要七个小时才能走完全程 457 英里（735 公里）。相比之下，火车可以在不到五个小时内完成意大利城市那不勒斯和米兰之间稍长的路线。 特拉华大学铁路工程和安全项目主任艾伦·扎伦斯基 (Allan Zarembski) 表示，东北走廊的铁轨无法容纳高速列车的部分原因是它们会根据地形而弯曲。改变这一点会很复杂。 “修直赛道是一项非常昂贵的提议，”他说。 “我必须获得土地。土地归某人所有，而且通常有人不想出售它。……我们正在谈论穿越美国人口最稠密的地区。” 虽然东北走廊目前还没有能力支持高铁，但加州曾希望树立一个积极的榜样。 2008年，该州发起了一项通过子弹头列车连接洛杉矶和旧金山的倡议。作为 12 小时非直达航班的大规模升级出售。

title.en: Trump's patriotic speech, colossal fireworks and white nationalists: US marks 250 years
title.zh: 特朗普发表爱国演说，巨型烟花与白人民族主义者：美国纪念250周年

summary.en: Donald Trump marked the 250th anniversary of America's independence with a patriotic speech and fireworks, following a two-hour evacuation of the National Mall due to storms. The event also saw the presence of white nationalists.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在美国独立250周年纪念活动上发表了爱国演说并举行了盛大烟花表演，此前国家广场因暴风雨而疏散了大约两小时。活动中也有白人民族主义者出现。

body.en:
Donald Trump praised the United States on its 250th birthday Sunday (AEST) as the "crowning achievement" of human history, as one of the world's largest fireworks displays lit up Washington and thousands of Americans saluted their country in nation-wide festivities.

In a speech delayed by several hours when storms forced the temporary evacuation of crowds in Washington, the US President claimed in his much-hyped speech that under his presidency the United States was "prouder than ever before".

"For two and a half centuries, our American republic has stood as the crowning achievement of human history," Trump told tens of thousands of people on the National Mall.

"Over 250 years the world has seen great empires, vast kingdoms, mighty nations, and terrible tyrants. They came and they went. But after two and a half centuries, this American republic still stands tall and strong."

The US leader also used the speech to renew attacks on domestic opponents he branded communists, push new voting restrictions and boast of the recent military campaigns against Iran and Venezuela, claiming that US had "wiped out" Iran's military.

A 40-minute long fireworks display, which organisers hope will break world records, then lit up the night sky over the National Mall.

Along with opposition against the politicisation of US indpendence day from some quarters in a country that has been deeply divided by his second term in office, Trump faced resistance from the elements.

Authorities allowed the crowd to return to an open field near the Washington Monument where Trump was due to speak, after ordering a weather-related evacuation that forced spectators to shelter in nearby museums and government buildings for a few hours.

While many streamed toward exits after the evacuation order, chaos broke out as other attendees refused to leave or tried to surge back in, shouting "charge!" and "Trump! Trump!"

Visitors had waited for hours to get into the event, contending with stepped-up security and temperatures reaching 39C. The record-breaking heat wave forced the cancellation of several parades and other events in the area.

The group posted on social media that it had arrived in the capital, and hundreds of people wearing the group's outfits travelled to the city on metro trains serving the District of Columbia region.

Past presidents have generally avoided in-person appearances at 4 July celebrations, but Trump has blurred the line between official commemoration and campaign-style politics.

title.en: On fourth of July, an American pope sends a symbolic letter to the US about immigrants
title.zh: 在七月四日，一位美国籍教宗向美国发出一封关于移民的象征性信函

summary.en: The American pope spent 4 July praying for migrants at the epicentre of Europe's migration debate.
summary.zh: 这位美国籍教宗在7月4日为欧洲移民辩论中心的移民祈祷，并向美国发出一封关于移民的象征性信函。

body.en:
Pope Leo XIV, who has sparred with the Trump administration over its immigration crackdown , has spent the fourth of July in the epicentre of Europe's migration debate to honour the tens of thousands of people who have died trying to reach Europe.

While the United States marks the 250th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence with rallies, parties and fireworks, the US-born Pope travelled to the Sicilian island of Lampedusa to pray at a migrant cemetery and celebrate a solemn Mass for the island's residents and newest arrivals.

Later on Sunday AEST, he got into the 4 July spirit with a visit to the residence of the US ambassador to the Holy See, Brian Burch, a rarity for popes who usually don't call on ambassadors.

The US embassy said Burch gave Leo a commemorative baseball, an apple pie and a US World Cup jersey.

Leo confirmed he was rooting for the US team, the embassy wrote on X, adding that the two discussed "American efforts to pursue peace, religious freedom and the need for moral clarity and courage around the world".

A treeless strip of rock nine kilometres long, Lampedusa is closer to Africa than the Italian mainland and is the main port of entry into Europe for hundreds of thousands of migrants who crossed by boat from Libya or Tunisia, often smuggled by human traffickers.

Leo met with some migrants at the port and then walked alone onto the jagged jetty rocks, the wind whipping his cassock and blowing his zucchetto skullcap off as he looked out to the sea.

He then blessed a plaque dedicating the dock to Pope Francis, who visited in 2013, before celebrating Mass on land.

In making the visit on this particular day, Leo was sending a powerfully symbolic message to the United States and Europe of the Christian obligation to uphold the dignity of every human being, migrants and the most vulnerable especially, while reminding the United States that it was founded by immigrants.

In a letter sent to Americans on the 4 July anniversary, Leo insisted that protecting the unborn and all human life also means "welcoming, protecting and assisting immigrants, whose hopes, sacrifices and contribution have formed part of the history of this country from its very beginning".

"To receive them with compassion and generosity is not only an act of charity, but also a recognition of the dignity that belongs to every human person," Leo wrote.

In recent years, Lampedusa has become ground zero of Europe's migration debate as the continent struggles to police its borders while honouring its legal obligations to welcome refugees fleeing conflict, climate change and poverty.

title.en: The World Cup Round of 16 is set. Here's every qualified team
title.zh: 世界杯十六强已确定。这是所有晋级球队

summary.en: The World Cup Round of 16 is set to begin, featuring the top teams in a series of highly anticipated knockout matches.
summary.zh: 世界杯十六强赛即将拉开帷幕，各支顶尖球队将在一系列备受期待的淘汰赛中展开角逐。

body.en:
After a dramatic Round of 32, with some big names being knocked out of the running, the race for the FIFA World Cup 2026 trophy is now down to 16 teams.

The first round knockout stage has now wrapped up, delivering no shortage of surprises.

Heavyweights Germany and the Netherlands were both eliminated after shock defeats to Paraguay and Morocco, respectively, in matches that both ended in penalty shootouts.

While Spain and France advanced with comfortable wins, England, Argentina, Portugal and Brazil had to fight tooth and nail to secure their places in the next stage.

For the Socceroos, it was the end of their World Cup journey after losing to Egypt in a nail-biting contest that ended in a penalty shootout.

While Australian fans may still be licking their wounds, the tournament goes on — and it's only going to get more exciting.

The Round of 16's first day kicks off with host-nation Canada versus Morocco at 3am Sunday morning (this and all following times are AEST).

Canada likely faces a tough challenge against the North African side, which made it all the way to the semi-final of the 2022 World Cup and is so far unbeaten in this year's tournament.

The victor of that match will take on whichever side emerges from the France-Paraguay stand-off, set for 7am Sunday.

France has performed strongly in this year's tournament and enters the Round of 16 undefeated, while Paraguay achieved the unexpected by eliminating Germany in the first knockout round.

Brazil has won more World Cups than any other nation and, save for a 1-1 draw with Morocco, has won every match of the tournament thus far.

Still, the South American champions are unlikely to have a walk in the park against the Norwegians and star striker Erling Haaland.

The winner of that match will advance to the quarter-finals, where they will face either Mexico or England, who meet at 10am on Monday at Mexico City Stadium, a venue that has already hosted some of the tournament's most memorable matches.

If you're only planning to watch some of the Round of 16, it's fair to say it could be worth setting your alarm for 5am on Tuesday to witness Spain and Portugal go head to head.

After being held to a draw by underdogs Cape Verde in the first group-stage game, Spain has gone on to win every match since.

While Portugal had a less flattering set of group-stage results, Cristiano Ronaldo's squad pulled out a dramatic comeback against Croatia in their Round of 32 match.

title.en: 'Destabilising ': Australia criticises China after ballistic missile test launch in the Pacific
title.zh: “破坏稳定”：澳大利亚批评中国在太平洋进行弹道导弹试射

body.en:
Australia and New Zealand have sounded the alarm after China confirmed it successfully tested a submarine-launched ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

Chinese state media Xinhua reported that the testing is part of China's annual military exercise, and it has alerted relevant countries in advance, in accordance with international law and rules.

China has no specific countries targeted and goals behind today's test, Xinhua said.

This comes after Australia and Fiji signed a major defence alliance earlier in the day, committing each country to come to the other's aid in case either is attacked.

Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Australian government had been advised in advance by China of the test.

"Australia has been clear with China that we regard this as destabilising to the region," she told reporters on Monday, moments before the launch was confirmed.

"This proposed test is in the context of a rapid military buildup by China, which is lacking in the transparency and reassurance as to intent that the region expects."

Wong said the test was "inconsistent" with Pacific leaders' requests for the ocean to be one "of peace".

"It appears that, despite our long-standing concerns about this type of activity, China carried out the test within hours of informing us," he said in a statement.

"The Pacific is an Ocean of Peace and we are deeply concerned by China's testing of nuclear-capable weapons into the South Pacific."

The Sydney Morning Herald and The Australian newspapers both earlier reported that Chinese officials briefed regional governments, including Australia, about an upcoming intercontinental ballistic missile test in the Pacific.

The Chinese embassy in Australia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

China last tested an intercontinental ballistic missile in 2024, a rare event that highlighted the country's increasing military capabilities.

Data from Starboard Maritime Intelligence, a New Zealand ship tracking company, showed three Chinese satellite-tracking vessels positioned throughout the Pacific.

Two vessels left China around 25 June and currently sit near the Federated States of Micronesia. The third departed China in early May and is currently at harbour in Fiji's capital, Suva.

body.en:
Fiji, which had grown closer to Beijing under its former leadership, will now consult Canberra on security developments.

Australia signed a new economic and defense alliance with Fiji on Monday, elevating ties between the two nations as Canberra seeks to check China's influence in region.

Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese signed the pact with his Fijian counterpart Sitiveni Rabuka, as he visited the capital of the South Pacific island, Suva. 

"The Ocean of Peace Alliance introduces mutual defense obligations, and there's no higher obligation than to come ​to each other's aid at a time of need," Albanese said in a joint news conference ​Rabuka.

"An attack on Fiji from ​an outside force ‌would trigger Australia's full support for Fiji and for its sovereignty," Albanese said.

"The Pacific is home. And that's why this visit matters for Australians. Tackling shared challenges. Creating new opportunities. Together," Albanese said earlier in a post on X, which included pictures from his visit. 

Under the Ocean of Peace Alliance pact, Fiji and Australia have agreed to consult each other over any "security-related development" which may threaten their sovereignty.

"The purpose of this treaty is to recognize and affirm the commitment between the parties to protect their sovereignty, secure their mutual defense and security interests and contribute to the stability and security of the Pacific," the deal reads. 

Australia already has defense treaties with the United States, New Zealand and Papua New Guinea.

Fiji, which grew closer to Beijing under its former prime minister Frank Bainimarama, is the latest to join the fold. This is also the nation's first such alliance.

In 2022 , China signed a secretive security alliance with the Solomon Islands, stoking fears that it could one day create a permanent military presence in the region.

However, Beijing's hold on the island waned after Rabuka came into power in 2022.

In 2025, the leader dismissed suggestions that the island may one day host a permanent Chinese military presence.

"If they want to come, who would welcome them? Not Fiji. And I think that China understands that well," he said at the time.

body.zh: 斐济在前任领导下与北京关系日益密切，现在将就安全事态发展与堪培拉进行磋商。 澳大利亚周一与斐济签署了新的经济和防务联盟，在堪培拉寻求遏制中国在该地区的影响力之际，提升了两国之间的关系。 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴内塞在访问南太平洋岛屿首都苏瓦时与斐济总理西蒂维尼·拉布卡签署了该协议。 阿尔巴内斯在拉布卡联合新闻发布会上表示：“和平海洋联盟引入了共同防御义务，没有比在需要时互相提供援助更高的义务了。” 阿尔巴内斯说：“外部力量对斐济的攻击将引发澳大利亚对斐济及其主权的全力支持。” “太平洋是家园。这就是为什么这次访问对澳大利亚人来说很重要。解决共同的挑战。创造新的机会。一起，”阿尔巴内斯早些时候在 X 上发表的一篇文章中说道，其中包括他访问的照片。 根据《海洋和平联盟》协议，斐济和澳大利亚同意就任何可能威胁其主权的“安全相关发展”进行相互磋商。 协议称：“该条约的目的是承认并确认双方保护主权、确保共同防御和安全利益并为太平洋地区稳定与安全做出贡献的承诺。” 澳大利亚已经与美国、新西兰和巴布亚新几内亚签订了防务条约。 斐济是最新加入的国家，在前总理弗兰克·拜尼马拉马 (Frank Bainimarama) 的领导下，该国与北京的关系日益密切。这也是全国首个此类联盟。 2022年，中国与所罗门群岛签署了一项秘密安全联盟，引发了人们对中国有一天可能在该地区建立永久军事存在的担忧。 然而，2022 年拉布卡上台后，北京对该岛的控制力减弱。 2025 年，这位领导人驳回了中国有一天可能在该岛驻军的建议。 “如果他们想来，谁会欢迎他们？斐济不行。我认为中国很理解这一点，”他当时说道。 中国官方媒体新华社周一报道称，北京从南太平洋地区的一艘潜艇试射了一枚装有假弹头的核弹道导弹，称这是“例行安排”。 此前，澳大利亚《悉尼先驱晨报》和《澳大利亚人报》报道称，中国官员已向包括澳大利亚在内的地区政府通报了即将进行的洲际导弹试验。 根据新西兰船舶跟踪公司提供的数据，三艘中国卫星跟踪船目前位于太平洋各处。

reflection.en: Nations often seek security through alliances and defense pacts, driven by concerns about regional stability and influence. Isaiah 41:10 reminds us not to fear or be dismayed, for Yahweh promises to strengthen and uphold us. While earthly partnerships offer a measure of security, ultimate peace and strength are found in Yahweh's unfailing presence.
reflection.zh: 国家常因对区域稳定和影响力的担忧而寻求联盟和防务协议。以赛亚书41:10提醒我们不要惧怕，也不要惊惶，因为雅伟应许要加添我们的力量，并扶持我们。虽然地上的伙伴关系提供了一定程度的安全，但最终的平安和力量在于雅伟永不失败的同在。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: China wants to solve the hardest problem in robotics – making hands
title.zh: 中国致力于解决机器人领域最棘手的问题——制造灵巧的机械手

summary.en: China is leading a global effort in robotics to develop highly dexterous artificial hands, considered the most challenging problem in creating "embodied AI." The goal is to transform humanoid robots from novelties into practical tools, highlighting the immense complexity of the human hand.
summary.zh: 中国正在机器人领域引领一项全球性努力，旨在开发高度灵巧的机械手，这被认为是创造“具身人工智能”中最困难的问题。其目标是将人形机器人从新奇玩意转变为实用工具，这凸显了人手的巨大复杂性。

body.en: Race to develop ‘embodied AI’ focuses on creating dextrous hands to transform humanoid robots from gimmicks into useful products Human hands – nimble, nerve-filled appendages that are the most flexible part of the human skeleton – are exceptionally complex. Many tasks that most people can do largely without thinking, from tying a pair of shoelaces to buttoning up a shirt, in fact require a complex set of neurological instructions and precise choreography. In thousands of years of human history, no machine has been able to truly replicate human’s greatest tool. But now, as artificial intelligence (AI) races forwards, some companies think they are close to surpassing this final but most difficult hurdle in robotics. Most of them are in China. As scientists strive to mimic this dexterity, we are reminded of Yahweh's marvelous handiwork in making us "fearfully and wonderfully." This pursuit of knowledge can deepen our appreciation for the original creation and the wisdom...
reflection.zh: 机器人技术中复制人手的努力，凸显了我们身体深刻的复杂性和精巧的设计。当科学家们努力模仿这种灵巧时，我们被提醒雅伟奇妙的创造，祂使我们“受造奇妙可畏”。这种对知识的追求可以加深我们对原始创造及其内在智慧的欣赏。

verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Bangladesh courts China even as ties with India improve
title.zh: 尽管与印度的关系有所改善，孟加拉国仍向中国示好

summary.en: Relations between Dhaka and Delhi, that turned frosty under the interim government, are on the mend.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Bangladesh's new government has sought greater Chinese investments and partnership to revive a stuttering economy, even as it attempts to re-balance ties with neighbouring India.

Bangladeshi Prime Minister Tarique Rahman went to Malaysia and China in his first overseas official visit last month, signalling the direction of Dhaka's foreign policy.

Analysts say the choice of destinations reflects Dhaka's effort to recalibrate its strategic priorities. While Rahman first visited Malaysia, his trip to China is seen as the more significant.

India has historically been the traditional port of call for newly-elected South Asian leaders. Some in India have viewed Rahman's China visit as a message to Delhi which has maintained close ties with the ousted Bangladeshi leader Sheikh Hasina.

Among several bilateral agreements, Rahman's outreach to Beijing for help managing the Teesta River and a deal to develop a special economic zone near Mongla port have attracted particular attention.

These are closely watched in Delhi as the two Asian giants compete for influence in Bangladesh.

Relations between Dhaka and Delhi turned frosty after the overthrow of prime minister Sheikh Hasina in August 2024 in a mass uprising. She fled the country and took refuge in Delhi.

Diplomatic ties remained strained after the interim government led by Muhammad Yunus took office, with India avoiding high-level visits.

After Rahman took over following a landslide victory for his Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) in February, both sides have taken initiatives to reset their ties.

"There is no doubt there has been a relative relaxation of tensions between the two countries," former Indian foreign secretary Shyam Saran told the BBC.

"The cross-border economic activities are gradually returning to normal and India is also issuing tourist visas to Bangladeshis," he said.

Passenger bus services between India and Bangladesh have partially resumed after an 18-month gap. Services now operate between Kolkata and Dhaka, and between Dhaka and Agartala.

When the war in the Middle East broke out earlier this year and hit global fuel supplies, Delhi sent thousands of tonnes of emergency fuel via the cross-border Friendship Pipeline to Bangladesh.

Last month, India's new High Commissioner to Dhaka, Dinesh Trivedi, took charge. In a rare move, Delhi elevated him to cabinet rank, signalling its intent to reset bilateral ties.

Despite diplomatic tensions and the two countries imposing tit-for-tat restrictions on trade when the interim government was in power, bilateral trade last year stood at around £13bn, mostly in India's favour.

Nevertheless, the rapprochement between Dhaka and Delhi is not as expected and there are continuing irritants in the bilateral relationship.

title.en: China's tech rise reshapes the global space race
title.zh: 中国科技崛起重塑全球太空竞赛

summary.en: China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.
summary.zh: 中国在全球研究排名中领先，并扩大了其在太空领域的雄心。随着技术领导力的增强，北京正将自己定位为全球范围内美国的竞争对手。

body.en:
China is pulling ahead in global research rankings and expanding its ambitions in space. With growing technological leadership, Beijing is positioning itself as a rival to the United States on a global scale.

Lai Kai-ying, the first female Chinese civilian to reach outer space, is currently on board China's crewed Tiangong space station , where she orbits the Earth 16 times a day, alongside two other Chinese astronauts.

Tiangong is a unique microgravity laboratory for scientific experiments, designed to provide new insights into humanity's future.

Today, aviation and spaceflight are once again shaped by ideological rivalry, echoing the mid-20th-century space race between the United States and the Soviet Union. In the 21st century, however, Washington's primary competitor is no longer Moscow, but Beijing.

US space agency NASA intends to retire its landmark research outpost, the International Space Station (ISS), by 2032. When that happens, China will be the only country operating a permanently crewed orbital station.

Space travel is just one of many fields worldwide in which China now holds a technological lead, according to Nature.

The journal's latest index of research leaders , which reveals the leading institutions and countries/territories, puts China in first place — well ahead of the United States and Germany . 

Nine of the Top 10 research institutions were from China, with the US' Harvard ranking third. Germany's Max Planck Society (MPG), Germany's preeminent research organization, ranked in 13th place.

"It is now almost irrelevant which global rankings you consult. Universities and research institutions in China lead in many fields," observed Christina Beck, spokesperson for the MPG.

The Nature Index also shows that Chinese research institutions are the clear leaders in biology, chemistry and physics, as well as in other applied sciences. Only in health sciences and the social sciences have they been surpassed by US institutions.

China's rise has taken place steadily over the past two decades, said Richard Heidler, director of information management at the German Research Foundation (DFG), Germany's largest research funding organization.

"While in the early 2000s it was primarily the volume of publications that increased significantly, bibliometric analyses over the past decade have also shown growing gains in impact-related indicators, such as the share and number of highly cited publications," Heidler said.

In other words, China is not only publishing more, but is becoming increasingly better and more visible, which the MPG's Beck said is based on a long-term development process.

body.zh: 中国在全球研究排名中处于领先地位，并扩大了其在太空领域的雄心。随着技术领先地位的不断增强，北京正在将自己定位为美国在全球范围内的竞争对手。 赖凯英是第一位到达外太空的中国女性平民，目前正在中国载人天宫空间站上，与另外两名中国宇航员一起每天绕地球运行 16 圈。 天宫是一个独特的微重力科学实验实验室，旨在为人类的未来提供新的见解。 如今，航空和航天再次受到意识形态竞争的影响，与20世纪中叶美国和苏联之间的太空竞赛相呼应。然而，进入21世纪，华盛顿的主要竞争对手不再是莫斯科，而是北京。 美国航天局 (NASA) 计划在 2032 年之前退役其具有里程碑意义的研究前哨站——国际空间站 (ISS)。届时，中国将成为唯一运营永久载人轨道站的国家。 据《自然》杂志报道，太空旅行只是中国目前在全球拥有技术领先地位的众多领域之一。 该杂志最新的研究领袖指数揭示了领先的机构和国家/地区，其中中国位居榜首，远远领先于美国和德国。 排名前十的研究机构中有九家来自中国，美国哈佛大学排名第三。德国杰出的研究组织德国马克斯·普朗克学会 (MPG) 排名第 13 位。 MPG发言人克里斯蒂娜·贝克(Christina Beck)表示：“现在，你参考哪个全球排名几乎已经无关紧要了。中国的大学和研究机构在许多领域都处于领先地位。” 自然指数还显示，中国研究机构在生物学、化学和物理学以及其他应用科学领域处于明显领先地位。只有在健康科学和社会科学领域被美国机构超越。 德国最大的研究资助机构德国研究基金会（DFG）信息管理部主任理查德·海德勒表示，中国在过去二十年中稳步崛起。 海德勒说：“虽然在 2000 年代初期，主要是出版物数量显着增加，但过去十年的文献计量分析也显示，与影响力相关的指标不断增长，例如高被引出版物的份额和数量。” 换句话说，中国不仅出版得更多，而且变得越来越好、越来越引人注目，MPG的贝克表示，这是基于长期发展过程的。 “其中的关键是多年来对中国科研机构和大学持续、系统的资助——......

reflection.en: Humanity's drive to innovate and achieve remarkable feats, like advancing in space and technology, is a powerful force. Yet, the story of Babel reminds us to reflect on the ultimate purpose of our collective ambitions and whether they serve a greater good or merely fuel rivalry. It encourages us to consider the heart behind our grandest endeavors.
reflection.zh: 人类在太空和科技领域不断创新并取得非凡成就的动力是强大的。然而，巴别塔的故事提醒我们反思集体雄心的最终目的，以及它们是为了更大的益处，还是仅仅助长了竞争。它鼓励我们思考我们最宏伟事业背后的心志。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'

title.en: China frees pastor after Trump raised case with Xi
title.zh: 中国在特朗普向习近平提出此案后释放牧师

summary.en: China has released a prominent underground church pastor following intervention from US President Donald Trump with Chinese leader Xi Jinping. The pastor's family expressed hope that this development signals greater religious freedom.
summary.zh: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向中国领导人习近平提出此案后，中国释放了一位著名的地下教会牧师。他的家人称此举是宗教自由的一个有希望的迹象。

body.en:
China has released the pastor of a prominent underground church after US President Donald Trump pressed his case with Chinese leader Xi Jinping. His family hailed the move as a hopeful sign for religious freedom.

China released underground church pastor Ezra Jin Mingri, who had been detained since October, his family and rights groups said on Sunday after he arrived in Los Angeles.

The release came less than two months after US President Donald Trump raised Jin's case with his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping during a visit to Beijing.

Jin founded Zion Church in Beijing in 2007, and it grew to around 1,500 members before authorities forced it to close in 2018.

He moved his family to the United States after officials targeted the church but later returned to China despite the risks. His daughter told US lawmakers last year that she had not seen her father in six years.

Jin's case gained international attention after Trump said he had also discussed the detention of Hong Kong pro-democracy publisher Jimmy Lai with Xi during the Beijing visit. Lai is serving a 20-year prison sentence in Hong Kong.

Jin's family said his release happened unexpectedly and credited both Trump and Xi with making it possible.

"We thank God for this tremendous miracle," Jin's daughter Grace said in a statement shared by a church member with the AFP news agency. 

"We hope this is a signal of a positive turn for people of faith in China and relations between our two nations." 

Trump said after returning from Beijing in May that he had asked Xi to release Jin. According to Trump, Xi replied that he would "strongly consider" the request.

Christian advocacy group ChinaAid welcomed Jin's release, saying he arrived safely in Los Angeles on Saturday after being held in the southern Chinese city of Beihai since October.

China's Foreign Ministry did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The White House also did not immediately comment.

Jin was among 18 leaders of Beijing's underground Zion Church who were detained in October and accused of illegally using information networks. His daughter Grace Jin said eight church members remain in detention.

"At least eight members of Zion Church remain detained in China," Maya Wang of Human Rights Watch wrote on X. "They should all be freed."

Zion Church is one of China's largest unregistered Protestant churches. Like other house churches, it operates outside the state-approved religious system, which requires worshippers to attend officially registered congregations.

China's ruling Communist Party, which is officially atheist, has tightened controls over religion under Xi, promoting the "Sinicization" of faith groups by demanding greater loyalty to the state.
body.zh: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向中国领导人习近平施压后，中国释放了一家著名地下教会的牧师。他的家人称赞此举是宗教自由的一个充满希望的迹象。 中国释放了地下教会牧师金明日 (Ezra Jin Mingri)，他自 10 月以来一直被拘留，他的家人和人权组织周日抵达洛杉矶后表示。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在访问北京期间向中国国家主席习近平提出了金的案件后不到两个月，就发布了这一消息。 金于 2007 年在北京创立了锡安教会，在当局于 2018 年强制关闭之前，该教会的成员人数已发展到约 1,500 名。 在官员袭击该教堂后，他举家移居美国，但后来不顾风险返回中国。他的女儿去年告诉美国立法者，她已经六年没有见到父亲了。 特朗普表示，他在北京访问期间还与习近平讨论了香港亲民主出版商黎智英的拘留问题，此后金的案件引起了国际关注。黎智英正在香港服刑 20 年。 金的家人表示，他的获释出乎意料，并称赞特朗普和习近平使之成为可能。 “我们感谢上帝创造了这个巨大的奇迹，”金的女儿格蕾丝在一名教会成员向法新社分享的声明中说。 “我们希望这是中国信仰人士和我们两国关系出现积极转变的信号。” 特朗普5月份从北京回来后表示，他已要求习近平释放金。据特朗普称，习近平回答说，他将“认真考虑”这一请求。 基督教倡导组织对华援助协会对金的获释表示欢迎，称金自十月以来一直被关押在中国南方城市北海，并于周六安全抵达洛杉矶。 中国外交部没有立即回应置评请求。白宫也没有立即发表评论。 金是10月份被拘留并被指控非法使用信息网络的北京地下锡安教会的18名领导人之一。他的女儿 Grace Jin 说，八名教会成员仍被拘留。 “至少八名锡安教会成员仍被拘留在中国，”人权观察组织的玛雅·王在X上写道，“他们都应该被释放。” 锡安教会是中国最大的未注册新教教堂之一。与其他家庭教会一样，它在国家批准的宗教体系之外运作，该体系要求信徒参加正式注册的教会。 中国执政的共产党是官方的无神论者，在习近平的领导下加强了对宗教的控制，通过要求对国家更加忠诚来促进信仰团体的“中国化”。

reflection.en: The release of the pastor offers a glimpse of hope for those who face hardship for their faith. Even in challenging circumstances, Yahweh promises a blessing to those who endure persecution for righteousness' sake. This event reminds us to pray for all who suffer for their convictions and for the spread of true freedom.

body.en:
Brussels has ended a customs exemption for low-value imports from China while agreeing with Beijing to monitor trade flows and improve access to rare earth materials.

Every day, around 16 million small, low-value packages arrive in the EU , 91% of which come from China .

Many of those parcels contain items that European shoppers order from cheap Chinese online shopping platforms such as Temu , Shein  and AliExpress. Until now, parcels valued at less than €150 ($171) were exempt from customs duties.

However, the EU this week ended that exemption and imposed a €3 levy on low-value imports in a move to curb what it sees as unfair competition, and to keep products that do not meet the bloc's safety standards out of the European market.

"Temu and Shein often fail to comply with legal and regulatory requirements, introduce unsafe products into our market that may pose health risks, and are driving many domestic retailers to the brink of ruin," said Alexander von Preen, president of the German Retail Association (HDE).

The customs duty exemption cost public finances at least €400 million annually, according to the association.

In 2025, Temu overtook Allegro as Poland's most-visited e-commerce platform, according to Mediapanel data. Justyna Szczudlik, a China analyst with the Polish Institute of International Affairs (PISM), pointed to data protection risks, intellectual property violations, and the possibility that Chinese platforms may collect large amounts of consumer data from Polish users.

The new €3 flat-rate charge is a temporary measure that is expected to remain in place until July 1, 2028, while the EU develops a new digital services platform. Once the new system is operational, standard customs duties based on a product's value, origin and classification will apply.

The EU also plans a handling fee to start in November 2026 to help customs authorities with their surging costs as more and more parcels arrive . The amount has yet to be decided.

"The status quo is not an option," EU Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic said after meeting Chinese Commerce Minister Wang Wentao in Brussels.

"My objective from the outset has been clear: to begin balancing the trade relationship between the European Union and China. The gap is widening. China's exports to the EU keep rising while our market share in China keeps shrinking. This trend is not sustainable."

In 2025, the EU exported goods worth €199.6 billion to China and imported goods worth €559.4 billion, resulting in a trade deficit of €359.8 billion.

title.en: 'I'm astounded': The visa fee that's nearly tripled in price
